ns2:section.sectionText: Online and Continuing Education (OCE) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.oce.illinois.edu. This online course uses both Illinois Compass (course learning management system) for asynchronous work and Elluminate for synchronous (live online) sessions. Students are highly recommended to have a reliable high-speed Internet connection and are required to have a microphone headset or external microphone for this course.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: OCE Tuition $452.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
